name: Bladder
summary: Tier 3, open at rung 5, and the one ordinary vessel whose authored tier sits inside the mortal band while its work is bookkeeping rather than strength. It holds what the body has decided not to spend. Damage here does not cripple; it exhausts, quietly and last, which is why it goes unreported for years.

name: Body Integration
summary: Integrity 160 and the frame stops disagreeing with itself - bone, muscle and fascia carrying one load instead of three. Physique 39, quality target 0.683. Twelve organs still closed at this gate, which is why a practitioner this dense is still carried by eight vessels.

name: Carapace Form
summary: Hardens the outer frame until qi runs along it like wire. Half elemental, so the form holds against wood and cracks against fire.

name: Core Formation
summary: Integrity 120 and a dense core forms where the ribs meet the spine, which is the first place the body can be built around something other than habit. Physique 20.2. Chance of the breakthrough holding falls to 0.474, and that falling number is the whole cost curve of this path: the denser the composition, the more ways it can fail to close.

name: Crane Dance Step
summary: Seven weight shifts a breath apart, each one still balanced. Mostly raw mechanics with the wind qi woven through, so it is a footwork art first and an element second.

name: Dao Ancestor
summary: Integrity 380, physique 199.6, and the composition carries a lineage - what it was before it was this, and which body first held it. Refinement 28. The price step here, 2800 over 2700, is the tightest on the ladder, so the shared rate may not outrun the work.

name: Dao Fruit
summary: Integrity 350, and the composition carries a fragment of the reading that produced it rather than just the charge. Fruit is perishable, so the gate is paid inside a window that closes. Physique 172, refinement 25, and no structural opening remains anywhere on the ladder above this realm.

name: Earth Immortal
summary: First immortal gate: integrity 280, refinement 18. Ten slots over six groups forces a second layer, and for this path that is a structural opening rather than a numerical one - a frame can finally hold matter it does not use. The nine celestial nodes on the four primary extraordinary vessels open here, each worth 800 capacity against a major node's 200.

name: Foundation
summary: Same price as Qi Refining on the qi ladder and the same reason: an entry gate has no predecessor to be cheaper than. Integrity 110, physique 16, and what changes is the composition's grain - the frame stops being the body it was born in. Still no qi spent, still four meridians, and the gate fee is still being paid in someone else's world.

name: Golden Immortal
summary: Integrity 300 and the composition begins to earn its own weight - star metal and immortal essence are the tier's resources, and a frame built on them is not assembled from anything the tier below can supply. Refinement 20, physique 130, and the chance of closure keeps falling to 0.330.

name: Great Ascension
summary: The twelfth meridian opens - pericardium, triple burner, gallbladder, liver - and integrity reaches 170 on a frame of physique 44.2. The name promises more than a three-slot world can grant: there is no ascension out of a mortal tier, only a composition that has run out of redundancy sooner than the qi path does.

name: Great Luo
summary: Integrity 340, physique 163.2, refinement 24, and the body is no longer a thing in a place but an extent - a frame whose constituents are spread across a layer and held in agreement. That is the setting's name for a net, and it is why the closing realms are the ones with no new vessel left to open.

name: Heaven Immortal
summary: Integrity 290, physique 122.2. The second layer is where the body's excess goes, and it is why an immortal-tier body can be dense without being brittle. Upkeep rather than lifespan is what kills at this tier: temporal reads to 50x, so a mortal life inside such a world is a rounding error.

name: Immortal Sovereign
summary: Integrity 360, the last immortal-band gate. Refinement 26, physique 181, quality target 0.893, chance 0.282. Fifteen slots over three layers is what waits above, and three layers means a frame this dense must hold across law lists it is not composed of.

name: Iron Skin
summary: Drives qi into the fascia until the skin stops being soft. Barely elemental, so it reads as blunt force taken rather than a strike dealt.

name: Mystic Immortal
summary: Integrity 310. The densest frames in the setting are indistinguishable from the matter around them, which is convenient and unprovable: a body this complete has no external reading to test it against. Physique 138, refinement 21, chance 0.322. Twenty meridians, unchanged since realm 17.

name: Nascent Soul
summary: Integrity 130, and the frame carries itself - a shape that holds without the will that learned it holding there. Physique 24.6, twelve meridian-free refinements available. Nothing elemental and nothing spatial is licensed here, so a body practitioner cannot reach for an effect this band's three slots simply do not hold.

name: Primordial Immortal
summary: Integrity 330, and the frame carries its own tide. A law value moves through its authored range on a cycle, and a body dense enough to register one can schedule its own maintenance against it. The tide cannot lift a law past value_max, and an out-of-range imprint tears.

name: Primordial Origin
summary: Integrity 390, the ceiling of the body path's own reservoir and the top of the authored ladder. Physique 209.2, refinement 29, quality target 0.9245 - a composition with almost nothing left that is not load bearing. Thirty realms is a content decision, not an argument that a thirty-first frame could not be built.

name: Qi Refining
summary: First gate: the composition is set rather than inherited, integrity ceiling 100 and physique 12 against an untrained frame. It costs the four digestive meridians open and no qi at all - this path spends no charge, which is why it is legible from a three-slot world at all. Mortal worlds license no humanoid, so a Body Dao practitioner at realm 1 is a visitor in a tier its own Dao cannot breed its own people in.

name: Spirit Ascension
summary: THE CEILING. Densest bodies stop at realm seventeen, one gate short of the end of their own tier, and nobody has explained it since. Integrity 270 is authored here and is reachable only without a new vessel: the network closed at Spirit Sovereign, so a frame this dense has no twenty-first conduit to open. The only surviving account of why is a stonecutter's - see history.consequence_the_density_ceiling, which still records the cause as unresolved.

name: Spirit Condensation
summary: First spirit gate: integrity 190 on twelve meridians, refinement 9. The tier's six slots hold all six groups for the first time, so a body this dense can finally be measured against an elemental it was previously untouched by. What it still cannot do is gather three groups into one shell: six imprints over 100-1000 units will not concentrate, so elemental life waits a tier.

name: Spirit Domain
summary: Integrity 250, physique 93, refinement 15, on eighteen meridians. The composition has reached the last gate before it closes, and a frame at this density has no duplicated group left to spare: the next vessel is the twentieth, and there is nothing after the twentieth.

name: Spirit Manifestation
summary: Integrity 220, physique 73.2, refinement 12, and the body can be read from outside - a dense enough composition prints its own outline in the law values it sits in. That is a diagnostic, not an attack, and it is the first body-path gate that needs a law group this path does not itself read.

name: Spirit Palace
summary: Integrity 210, and the composition grows a room rather than more wall - somewhere inside the frame that is not carrying anything and can therefore be spent. Physique 67. Sixteen meridians. Spirit-tier law has stopped being the constraint; room inside a layer has become it, and this path is the one that notices first.

name: Spirit Sea
summary: The four extraordinary vessels open - du, ren, chong, dai - taking the network to sixteen and integrity to 200. A dense body needs conduits that are not organs, because organs cannot be thickened without becoming something else. Physique 61, refinement 10, and the meridian network's most numerous and least redundant part is now carrying the most weight.

name: Spirit Severing
summary: The qiao vessels open for eighteen and integrity reaches 230. Severing is the body's costliest topological gate: a dense frame whose conduits cross itself has to be dense at the crossing too, and that is where the chance of closure falls to 0.386. Physique 79.6, progress 138.

name: Spirit Sovereign
summary: Integrity 260 and the twentieth meridian opens - yin wei, yang wei. The network is now closed at twenty, fourteen organ and six extraordinary, and this is the last realm on the ladder that adds one. Every realm above adds density to a composition with nothing left in it to give.

name: Spirit Transformation
summary: The second group opens - heart, small intestine, bladder, kidney - for eight meridians, and integrity reaches 140. That is the gate: four more load-bearing vessels under a heavier frame. Mortal band, three slots, and the body's own Dao still names this tier as home while the tier refuses to license anyone to live in it.

name: Spirit Unity
summary: Integrity 240, and the crossing at the qiao vessels stops being a fault and becomes a load path. Eighteen meridians, physique 86.2, quality target 0.767. Nothing about the world's budget has changed here; what changed is that a body this built can no longer be described by one of its parts.

name: Stone Anchor Stance
summary: A stance that spends the whole body's weight instead of its speed. No qi, no element; it exists so the practitioner cannot be moved while it is held.

name: Thunder Claw
summary: Discharges from the point of contact outward through the target's own frame. Almost pure lightning riding a physical grip; the deepest body technique in the tree.

name: Tiger Palm
summary: A short palm driven off the heel with nothing elemental in it at all. Every point of its output is raw body mass, so no element matchup can blunt it.

name: Transcendent
summary: Integrity 370, refinement 27, and the third set of celestial nodes opens - one more on ren, chong and dai, each 800 capacity. The tier's shortage is will rather than law: fifteen imprints over three layers take a holder to maintain, so a body this complete is now something that must be fed as well as built.

name: Tremor Cadence
summary: Sends a resonance down through whatever the practitioner is standing on. Ground-carried, so it finds the feet before it finds the chest.

name: Tribulation
summary: Integrity 180, the last mortal gate, on twelve meridians and eight refinements. The body's tribulation is not weather: it is the composition failing to close, at a base chance of 0.426 and falling by 0.008 a realm. Three law slots and a qi value at its floor set the ceiling, not the practitioner.

name: True Immortal
summary: Integrity 320, physique 146.2, refinement 22, and the composition no longer needs the tier to supply it - which is the honest name for this gate. All six law groups are present at high values here, so the limit is the practitioner's own supply of the material rather than the world's.

name: Void Refinement
summary: Integrity 150, spent removing everything in the composition that is not load bearing. Refinement fifth, physique 34. This is the body's answer to the qi path's void: subtraction, because a dense frame has no room for filler and filler is what fails first under a law value pressed past its range.

name: Du Mai Celestial Node 01
summary: A celestial node on Du Mai, worth 800 capacity - sixteen minor nodes, four major - and opened at rung 19, where ten law slots over six groups forces a second layer, and a second layer is the first structure a body can add material to. Node 1 of twelve, and they exist only on the four primary extraordinary vessels, so no ordinary organ ever carries one. Losing this is not a reduction; the vessel it sits on has nothing above it to carry the load.

name: Chong Mai
summary: The vessel of the deeper sea, tier 9, opening at rung 11, and the one whose name is shared with the mind path's reservoir for reasons nobody has finished arguing about. It is thick, capacious and slow. Four nodes, and the third celestial node on it does not open until rung 28.

name: Dai Mai
summary: The belt vessel, tier 9, open from rung 11, and the only extraordinary vessel that holds rather than transmits - it binds what the other seven carry. A body whose dai is damaged is not disconnected but uncontained: everything works and nothing stays where it was put.

name: Du Mai
summary: The governing vessel of the back and the spine, tier 9, opening at rung 11 when the extraordinary vessels arrive. It is not an organ and cannot be thickened like one, which is exactly what a dense body needs and cannot get anywhere else. It carries four nodes of its own - two major, two celestial - the fullest allotment on any vessel.

name: Quiet Pulse
summary: Slows the heartbeat and the attention in the same count, which neither half can do alone. Barely elemental; almost all of it is the recovery itself.

name: Steel Recollection
summary: The body repeats a movement the mind still remembers exactly. Purely raw output and no elemental term at all, so nothing resists it; the price is that both paths must already be at the Immortal floor.

name: Unbroken Centre
summary: Keeps the body's repair budget and the mind's attention in the same reserve. General regeneration and mental clarity, the one passive a mortal-graded build can still reach on either path.

name: Unnamed Order
summary: A lineage of posture drill kept for three hundred years because nobody could name why it worked. Muscle fibre and mental defence, the only dual passive that pays a raw structural option beside a defensive one, and it needs both paths at the top of the ladder to learn.

name: Iron Marrow
summary: Runs qi through the marrow rather than around the muscle, so the blow carries the weight of both halves. Six tenths metal: weak against fire, strong against wood.

name: Metal Lattice
summary: Stiffens the frame into a lattice qi can be stored in, which is why the technique holds a target in place rather than moving it. Both paths have to be deep.

name: Stout Root
summary: Fuses the dantian's reservoir into the skeleton so the body stops being a separate machine. Denser bone and a deeper dantian: the only passive carrying one structural option and one qi option together.

name: Tempered Frame
summary: Repeatedly loads a qi-filled frame until the frame absorbs what the qi cannot. Greater carry and organ vitality, paid for in stamina every minute it is equipped.

name: Both Eyes Open
summary: Trains the practitioner to notice the body's warning and the mind's misreading in the same instant. Perception and mental clarity, on the one cadence only a dual path has.

name: Clarity Edge
summary: Strikes with qi held perfectly still, which only a mind that cannot be startled can do. Mostly light, so a dark-veined body takes it badly.

name: Harmony Cadence
summary: A counting pattern that keeps the two halves from drifting apart over a long practice. Steadier qi control and slightly better dual-path progress; it is the only passive that pays qi control AND a dual-path rate.

name: Shared Pulse
summary: Runs one circuit from the dantian up through the mind and back, so each half feeds the other. Unelemental, so there is no matchup to read, and both paths must be at the floor before it can be learned.

name: Gallbladder
summary: Tier 6, added at rung 8, and the vessel that stores rather than moves. On the qi path it is where refined charge is kept between gates; on the body path it is the densest ordinary tissue available before the extraordinary vessels open. Loss is survivable and irreversible, and every world prices the treatment.

name: Heart
summary: Opens at rung 5, the first meridian added after the mortal entry gate. It is the organ a body path practitioner thickens first and a mind practitioner uses as an anchor to leave and return to - the one place both readings of the ladder agree on. Damage is the fastest route to a stopped heart, and no technique on any rung substitutes for it.

name: Kidney
summary: Tier 3, added at rung 5, and the vessel every tradition on every path treats as the one that stores what refinement is for later. It is the reason the ladder has an order at all: nothing else in the body holds a resource across a gate. Damage is the failure the whole ladder is designed to postpone.

name: Large Intestine
summary: Tier 0, open from the first rung, and the vessel that decides what the intake is allowed to become. It is the reason a three-slot world's life_law imprint shows up in a practitioner's gut before it shows up anywhere else. Damage here reads as a body that eats and does not benefit, which is why it is the hardest ordinary vessel to distinguish from ordinary illness.

name: Liver
summary: Tier 6 and the last ordinary vessel to open, at rung 8. It is the largest of the twelve and the one that has to be rebuilt rather than merely opened, which is why the rung-8 gate costs twelve vessels and not thirteen. Damaged, a body can still cultivate and simply stops being able to.

name: Lung
summary: Opens at the first rung and governs the intake the whole ladder is built on. Tier 0, so it belongs entirely to the mortal band: a body can only be held together here because three law slots paid for exactly the intake, the digestion and the beast-strength a mortal world needs. Damage shows as shallow breath before it shows as weakness, and the qi path cannot draw a breath it does not have.

name: Du Mai Major Node 01
summary: A major node on Du Mai, worth 200 capacity - four times a minor node - and opened at rung 10, where six law slots first hold all six groups at once. This is node 1 of twelve, and there are eight of them on eight vessels: the first expansion that costs something other than time. Damage here is structural, because the extraordinary vessels have no minor node to absorb the load.

name: Abyssal Drown
summary: Floods a mind's own recall until it cannot separate a real memory from a planted one. Two thirds water, so fire burns the flood out and an empty mind drowns in nothing.

name: Body Integration
summary: Sea 250 and the cultivator can hold a self and a body at once without one cancelling the other. This is the gate Mind Dao's conflict with Body Dao is about: Body reads spatial as a container that holds, Mind reads it as an exit the self leaves by. Clarity 0.49, purity 0.54, eight meridians.

name: Core Formation
summary: Sea 150, comprehension 30, and the sea stops being a surface and starts having depth. Purity 0.48 is the real gate: an impure sea confuses what is remembered with what is understood, and this is where that stops being survivable. Four meridians, unchanged since realm 1.

name: Dao Ancestor
summary: Sea 800, clarity 0.82, purity 0.87, and the self held carries a lineage: which minds first formed it and what they were before. The price step here, 2800 over 2700, is the tightest on the authored ladder, so the shared per-realm rate may not outrun the work.

name: Dao Fruit
summary: Sea 725, clarity 0.78, purity 0.82, and the self held carries a fragment of the reading rather than the reading's charge. Fruit is perishable, so the gate is paid inside a window. No structural opening remains on the ladder above this realm.

name: Earth Immortal
summary: First immortal gate: sea 550 and the sea's tier becomes vast. Clarity 0.67, purity 0.72. Ten slots over six groups leaves four to duplicate, and the second layer is what lets a self be held apart from more than one region at a time. Elemental life appears at exactly this budget, and a mind practitioner here has something non-human to reason against for the first time.

name: Foundation
summary: Deliberately the same price as Qi Refining - 100 progress, the same sea capacity 125 - because an entry gate has no predecessor to be cheaper than. What changes is the sea's floor: it holds a little longer between sittings. Mind cultivation is cheap to enter and slow to widen, and the clarity requirement only reaches 0.42 here.

name: Glare of Warding
summary: Returns an attacker's own attention back along the line it arrived on. Half light, so it is strong against dark and indifferent to everything else.

name: Golden Immortal
summary: Sea 600 and the self held is old enough to have been other things - clarity 0.70 against purity 0.75 is the first gate where the two requirements separate sharply. The cost is a sea catalyst per realm and 7700 progress, and neither is optional.

name: Great Ascension
summary: The fourth digest gate opens - pericardium, triple burner, gallbladder, liver - for twelve meridians and sea 275. Physically the same conduits the body path needs; here they are read as the anchor a self leaves and returns to, which is why a mind practitioner who stops returning loses clarity faster than they lose sea.

name: Great Luo
summary: Sea 700, clarity 0.76, purity 0.81, and the sea stops being a depth and becomes an expanse that holds a region rather than a state. This is the setting's word for a net, and it is the same word the body path uses for a frame spread across a layer - reached from opposite directions through one shared law group.

name: Heaven Immortal
summary: Sea 575, clarity 0.69, purity 0.73. The second layer is the mind path's opportunity and its trap: a self held apart in it is further from any body, which raises clarity and drops the body's own hold on it. Upkeep rather than lifespan is what kills here; temporal reads to 50x.

name: Illusion Lattice
summary: Builds a lattice of false readings and leaves it standing around the practitioner. Unelemental, sustained, and priced by clarity rather than by qi.

name: Immortal Sovereign
summary: Sea 750, the last immortal-band gate. Clarity 0.79, purity 0.84, 11264 progress. What waits above is not more sea but fifteen imprints over three layers - and a mind practitioner at this depth is the only path already reading spatial the way the top tier reads it.

name: Mirror Reversal
summary: Splits an incoming impression and sends half of it back down the same path. A dark reflection, so it is weakest against light and best against its own kind.

name: Mystic Immortal
summary: Sea 625, clarity 0.72, purity 0.77. A self this refined cannot be verified from outside, because there is no observation anyone can make that would distinguish a well-held one from a merely reported one. Mind Dao's oldest problem, and this is the realm where it stops being answerable by practice.

name: Nascent Soul
summary: Sea 175 and the self being cultivated is separable from the one doing the cultivating - which is the claim every Mind tradition rests and none can prove inside a mortal world. Clarity 0.45, purity 0.49, 492 progress. No spatial imprint exists at this band, so the separation is asserted rather than shown.

name: Prime Autopsy
summary: Walks a hostile intention back to the first decision that produced it. Entirely dark: nothing resists it except light, and the qi bill is the steepest in the mind tree.

name: Primordial Immortal
summary: Sea 675, and the mind carries its own tide - a periodic movement inside a law's authored range that a self can schedule its clarity against rather than wait on. Clarity 0.74, purity 0.79. A tide cannot lift a law past value_max, and an out-of-range imprint tears.

name: Primordial Origin
summary: Sea 825, clarity 0.83, purity 0.89 - the top of the authored ladder, and the only band where mind_dao's own reading is fully legible. Thirty realms is a content decision rather than an argument that a thirty-first could not exist. What stops here is the number written down, not the sea's capacity.

name: Qi Refining
summary: First gate: comprehension becomes a measurable quantity and a sea forms to hold it, capacity 100 at clarity 0.40 and purity 0.45. It costs the four digestive meridians open and a sea catalyst, which is a per-realm item no other path needs. A three-slot world writes no spatial imprint, and this is the path whose whole practice is leaving a body - so realm 1 practises the one reading its Dao cannot afford here.

name: Revelation Lance
summary: A single named fact, driven hard enough to be believed. Almost pure light and carried on the intent rather than the will, so it lands on illusions and sceptics alike.

name: Spirit Ascension
summary: Sea 525, the top of the spirit band and the last realm before a world needs two law lists to hold itself. Clarity 0.66, purity 0.71. Six slots let a self be held apart from a body; ten slots let it be held apart from a layer, which is a different claim and costs three times the law supply to test.

name: Spirit Condensation
summary: First spirit gate, and the sea's own tier changes from shallow to deep: capacity 325, clarity 0.54, purity 0.58. Six law slots hold all six groups here, so mind_dao's spatial read finally has an imprint to push against. It is still only six slots, so no single body gathers three groups and no elemental life exists to be mistaken for a rival mind.

name: Spirit Domain
summary: Sea 475, purity 0.68, and the self being cultivated has a boundary it maintains rather than one it defends. Eighteen meridians. The band is nearly spent; the next gate opens the last two vessels and closes the network for good.

name: Spirit Manifestation
summary: Sea 400 and what is held in the sea can be projected out of the body as perception rather than as force. Clarity 0.58, purity 0.63, refinement 13. With all six groups written at this tier, a projected mind can meet an elemental - the first thing on this ladder with anything to meet.

name: Spirit Palace
summary: Sea 375, and there is architecture in it - compartments the self can be held in separately, which is the practical difference between depth and size. Physique is not on this gate at all; the cost is clarity 0.56 and 3236 progress. Sixteen meridians, and a sea this deep starts answering to its own structure.

name: Spirit Sea
summary: The extraordinary vessels open - du, ren, chong, dai - for sixteen and sea 350. The network now crosses, and a mind practitioner uses the crossing rather than fighting it: the qiao vessels are the fastest route between two states of attention. Comprehension 270, clarity 0.55.

name: Spirit Severing
summary: The qiao vessels open for eighteen and sea 425. Severing is a mind gate before it is a body one: the self is separated from a specific attachment rather than a limb. Purity 0.65 is the price, comprehension 426, and the cost curve has begun to outrun the work.

name: Spirit Sovereign
summary: Sea 500 and the twentieth meridian opens - yin wei, yang wei - closing a network of fourteen organ and six extraordinary vessels. Refinement 17, clarity 0.64, purity 0.69. Nothing above this realm reopens it, so every deeper gate adds depth to a sea inside a closed body.

name: Spirit Transformation
summary: The second group opens - heart, small intestine, bladder, kidney - for eight meridians and sea 200. The mind ladder's version of this gate is that perception stops being tied to the senses that the physical law supplies. Still mortal band, still three slots, and the group's sharpness is now measurable rather than claimed.

name: Spirit Unity
summary: Sea 450 and the compartments hold together as one awareness instead of several. Clarity 0.61, purity 0.66. This is the state Mind Dao calls unity and Body Dao calls a cage: the same observation, read through spatial law in opposite directions, which is why the two traditions treat each other's peak as a pathology.

name: Still Water
summary: Flattens the surface of the mind so an incoming impression has nothing to break against. Almost no element, because it does no damage to anybody.

name: Transcendent
summary: Sea 775, clarity 0.80, purity 0.85, and the first realm on the path's own home tier. Fifteen slots over three layers, which takes a will to hold rather than a sea to fill - so mind_dao's spatial read finally has the size it needs. The third set of celestial nodes opens here, on ren, chong and dai.

name: Tribulation
summary: Last gate of the mortal band: sea 300, clarity 0.52, purity 0.57, twelve meridians. The cost is that a strained qi_law returns the floor reading no matter how much is pushed into it, so the attempt must be ridden on a tide crest. Mind Dao is allied with Qi Dao and shares qi_law and temporal_law, which is why the tide governs this path as much as the qi one.

name: True Immortal
summary: Sea 650 and the cultivation needs no world to continue in. Clarity 0.73, purity 0.78, comprehension 1110. Ten slots, two layers, all six groups high - so the limit is the practitioner's own supply, and a high realm is a passport into exactly one law set and a liability in every other.

name: Void Refinement
summary: Sea 225, and everything in it that was not understood is emptied out. Mind purification is subtraction before it is anything else, and the purity floor rises to 0.53 to price it. Refinement six, comprehension 90, and 1032 progress - the first step on this path that is genuinely steep.

name: Lung Minor Node 01
summary: One of 36 minor nodes, 50 capacity each and opened at rung 1 - the only nodes a three-slot mortal world can afford, since they cost nothing but an open Lung. Damage takes 1 off the frame rather than stopping anything: a minor node is a convenience, and the ladder is built to lose them. Node 1 is the third on its vessel, so a body that has lost two still reads as whole.

name: Barrier Cultivation
summary: Practises holding a wall up while deliberately having it struck. Mental defence and resistance to illusion, trained as two separate muscles.

name: Clear Mind Sitting
summary: A daily sitting that empties the head before the day starts. Mental clarity and a sharper read on the room; it is the cheapest passive in the codex.

name: Dantian Reservoir Manual
summary: A drawing and breathing scheme for holding qi in the lower field without straining. Deeper reservoir and steadier regrowth; it grants no power at all.

name: Echo Resonance Notes
summary: Records how a qi technique felt at its best and how to reproduce that exact state on demand. The notes raise technique power and clarity of mind together.

name: Marrow Circulation Primer
summary: Teaches qi to take the short route through the long bones. Steadier qi control and better affinity to outside energy, and nothing that helps a strike land.

name: Osteomantic Frame
summary: A loading routine for the long bones. Denser skeleton and better muscle fibre; a practitioner who trains this hits harder and still does not cast qi.

name: Quick Reaction Drill
summary: Repetition at speed until the first answer arrives before the question finishes. Dodge chance and mental attack, which is what a technique-carrying duellist wants.

name: Second Wind Discipline
summary: Trains the body to keep a larger share of its load, so less of each effort has to be paid for out of qi. Greater carry and faster recovery than the frame it sits on.

name: Still Point
summary: A discipline of holding the qi still at the moment of release. Every technique casts cheaper for it, which is the one thing that compounds at mastery.

name: Vital Organ Cycle
summary: A breathing cycle that keeps the organs supplied under strain. Organ vitality and general regeneration, bought with a slow, dull price that has to be paid forever.

name: Pericardium
summary: Opens at rung 8 and is not an organ so much as the membrane the other eleven run inside. A body without a sound pericardium can have every ordinary vessel open and still fail to hold a technique for more than a breath. It is the frame, and it is why the rung-8 gate is a gate rather than four more names on a list.

name: Body Integration
summary: Capacity 250, and the dantian learns to hold against the body's own physical law rather than only against the breath that built it. The cost is the third meridian group becoming load bearing - pericardium, triple burner, gallbladder and liver are still closed at 599, so the practitioner carries a bigger reservoir on eight vessels. Three law slots; nothing is unlocked here that the band above would not also permit.

name: Cinder Lance
summary: A narrow spear of fire that overheats the air it crosses. Almost all of it is elemental, so fire resistance eats the hit and water doubles what gets through.

name: Core Formation
summary: Capacity 150, and the dantian develops a floor of its own - a core that qi circulates around instead of pooling in. The cost is comprehension as much as progress: the practitioner has to hold the circulation through an exhale, which is a skill and not a quantity. Three slots still pay for exactly three groups, so nothing here touches element, space or time.

name: Dao Ancestor
summary: Capacity 800, and the qi held is old enough to carry a lineage - where it came from, and what shape the first body that drew it had. The third layer is added rather than opened. Progress here is the tightest step on the authored ladder, 2800 over 2700, so the rate may not outrun the price.

name: Dao Fruit
summary: Capacity 725, and the qi carries something of the law set that produced it - a usable fragment of a reading rather than the reading's raw charge. Fruit is perishable, so the gate is paid in a window that closes. Dao fruit is the tier's own resource, and the tier is nobody's home.

name: Earth Immortal
summary: Capacity 550, and the first immortal-tier gate: ten law slots over six groups leaves four to duplicate, and a duplicate only has somewhere to sit if a second layer exists. So the tier is layered by arithmetic, not decoration. The first nine celestial nodes also open here, and this is where elemental life becomes possible at all - three groups gathered in one shell.

name: Foundation
summary: Deliberately the same price as Qi Refining - 100 progress, capacity 125 - because an entry price with no predecessor has nothing to be cheaper than. What changes is the wall, not the volume: the dantian stops leaking on the exhale and can be filled deliberately. Still mortal band, still three slots, and no temporal imprint means the attempt waits on a tide rather than on a season.

name: Frost Anchor
summary: Locks a standing pool of cold in place rather than throwing it. The qi stays where it is put, which is what makes it a control art instead of a damage one.

name: Gale Step
summary: A short lateral displacement on a current of air. Half of the qi leaves as raw momentum, so it costs less to move than to strike.

name: Golden Immortal
summary: Capacity 600, and qi stops being a quantity with a shape and becomes a material with a yield. The gate is priced in immortal essence and star metal rather than in ore. Twenty meridians, unchanged since Spirit Sovereign, carry a reservoir now two and a half times the width of the one it started from.

name: Great Ascension
summary: The fourth digest gate: capacity 275 on all twelve organ meridians, at 700 progress. The name is aspirational inside the band - there is no ascension out of a mortal world, only a deeper seat in one. With three slots and qi at the floor, the ceiling of this entire band is set by the world's law values rather than by the practitioner.

name: Great Luo
summary: Capacity 700, and the reservoir stops being one body of qi and becomes a net that catches what the layer carries. The name is the setting's name for an expanse rather than a quantity. Nine realms into a ten-slot tier, and still nothing structural to open: the network closed at Spirit Sovereign.

name: Heaven Immortal
summary: Capacity 575, and the second layer is where the qi practitioner actually works: a reservoir held in the upper layer while the body keeps the lower one. The cost is upkeep - immortal-tier temporal reads to 50x, so a mortal lifespan inside such a world is a rounding error. No Dao is native to this tier, which makes it the one every path passes through.

name: Heavenly Glare
summary: Every particle of the technique is light, with no raw share to soften it. The highest ceiling in the tree and the steepest qi bill that goes with it.

name: Immortal Sovereign
summary: Capacity 750, the last immortal-band gate before fifteen slots over three layers. Twenty meridians, twenty realms of volume behind them, and no structure left to add. What changes at the boundary is not the practitioner but the number of law lists a world has to be held in - one list becomes two, then three.

name: Marrow Surge
summary: Forces qi down the opened channels all at once instead of spending it evenly. Raw output, no element, so nothing resists it and nothing amplifies it either.

name: Metal Edge
summary: Collapses a year of refined qi into one hard line. The sharpest thing a mortal hand can throw, and the cheapest way to find out what metal actually overcomes.

name: Mystic Immortal
summary: Capacity 625, and the qi stops announcing itself - the layer it sits in does not advertise its value to anything reading the same groups. This is the deepest a single reservoir gets before the band spends itself. The meridian network has been closed for eight realms and nothing here reopens it.

name: Nascent Soul
summary: Capacity 175, and the circulation stops depending on the breath - the first gate a body can hold while asleep, which is why it is named for a soul rather than a technique. It costs 300 progress and the same four meridians, unchanged since Qi Refining, because a three-slot world cannot afford to make a fifth vessel matter. Nothing elemental is available at this band at any effort.

name: Primordial Immortal
summary: Capacity 675, and the qi is old enough to have its own tide - a periodic movement inside the authored range that a practitioner can schedule to rather than wait on. The tide cannot lift a law past value_max; a surge that reaches the end of the range is out of range, and an out-of-range imprint tears.

name: Primordial Origin
summary: Capacity 825, the top of the authored ladder and the end of it. Thirty realms is a content decision rather than a cosmological argument that a thirty-first could not exist; what stops here is the number of realms written down. Nothing structural opens, because the meridian network closed eleven realms ago and no law slot buys a twenty-first vessel.

name: Qi Refining
summary: First gate: breath is drawn down and held in a dantian that has never held anything, so capacity is 100 and no later mortal gate is cheaper. It costs the four digestive meridians open - lung, large intestine, stomach, spleen - because three law slots afford physical, life and qi and nothing else. With no temporal imprint written there is no season to time the attempt to; the only window is a qi tide lifting the floor value.

name: Serpent Rain
summary: Condenses falling moisture into a field of downward strokes. Three quarters elemental: strong against fire, thin against anything that drinks.

name: Spirit Ascension
summary: Capacity 525, the top of the spirit band and the last realm before ten law slots split into two layers. It buys volume and nothing structural, because the network closed at Spirit Sovereign. Above here the practitioner's tolerance, not their network, is what the world presses on - and a body tuned this finely is also a body that reads one world precisely and brittles in the next.

name: Spirit Condensation
summary: First spirit gate and the first realm on the path's own home tier: capacity 325. Six law slots now hold all six groups, so an elemental technique finally has something to act on - elemental damage becomes a real quantity rather than a missing one. Nothing may yet gather three groups in a single body, so no elemental life exists here to fight. Humanoids are licensed first at this tier, which is why qi_dao has a native population at all.

name: Spirit Domain
summary: Capacity 475 on eighteen meridians, and qi held inside a fixed area begins to answer to its own boundary. The band is nearly spent: the next gate is the one that opens the last two vessels. A spirit-tier realm is a band of tolerated law pressure, not a promotion, so the same number in a smaller world describes a body held closer to breaking.

name: Spirit Manifestation
summary: Capacity 400, and qi leaves the body and keeps its shape outside it. This is the spirit-tier climax for the qi path: with all six groups written, a projected qi can finally carry an element, because there is an elemental share in a substance to strike. Six slots still cannot concentrate three groups in one shell, so an elemental body - and nothing like one - waits for the tier above.

name: Spirit Palace
summary: Capacity 375, and inside the reservoir there is now structure - rooms, walls, a place to put something other than more qi. This is the gate that turns storage into a seat, and it is why the ladder stops talking about volume. Sixteen meridians carry it. Spirit-tier law is no longer the constraint; room inside a layer is.

name: Spirit Sea
summary: The extraordinary vessels open - du, ren, chong and dai - taking the gate to sixteen and capacity to 350. Four new conduits turn a pool into a system, and the 1000 progress buys the routing rather than the volume. Spirit-tier worlds span 100-1000 units and temporal_law reads to 10x, so lives here are brief and breakthroughs quick: upkeep, not lifespan, is what kills.

name: Spirit Severing
summary: The qiao vessels open - yin qiao and yang qiao - for eighteen and capacity 425. Severing is the first spirit-band gate whose difficulty comes from topology rather than volume: the network now crosses itself. The cost is 1300 progress at a rate that has begun to outpace the work, so a practitioner must be lucky as well as trained.

name: Spirit Sovereign
summary: Capacity 500 and the twentieth meridian opens - yin wei and yang wei. This is the last realm on the ladder that adds a vessel, and the meridian network is now closed: twenty meridians, fourteen of them organ, six extraordinary, with nothing held back. Every realm above this one adds magnitude to the same closed composition.

name: Spirit Transformation
summary: The second meridian group opens - heart, small intestine, bladder, kidney - and capacity reaches 200. That is the whole gate: four more named vessels, and a dantian that can be fed from somewhere other than the gut. Still mortal band. Mortal worlds license no humanoid, so a qi practitioner here is a visitor paying a gate fee in a tier its own Dao cannot claim.

name: Spirit Unity
summary: Capacity 450, and the two halves of the crossed network are read as one circuit rather than two. Eighteen meridians, 1400 progress. Nothing in the spirit tier's budget is being spent differently here - what changes is that the practitioner can no longer be routed around, which is why a spirit-band body is described as held closer to its tolerance.

name: Thunder Severing
summary: A discharge so brief it has no travel time worth naming. Almost pure elemental, so it is the technique most worth mastering rather than the cheapest one to cast.

name: Transcendent
summary: Capacity 775, and the first realm on a tier whose shortage is will rather than law: fifteen imprints over six groups needs three layers, and no single will holds fifteen at once. The third set of celestial nodes opens here. A qi practitioner at this depth is far below its own Dao's ceiling, because qi_dao's home is the tier beneath this one.

name: Tribulation
summary: Last gate of the mortal band: capacity 300, 800 progress, twelve meridians. The cost is the attempt itself, because a strained qi_law spends everything you push into it and returns the floor reading, so a breakthrough here must be ridden on a qi tide crest. There is no temporal imprint to give the tide a calendar, which is why the whole band feels like one long trough with brief crests.

name: True Immortal
summary: Capacity 650, and the practitioner stops needing a second layer to survive in the first. Ten slots, two layers, all six groups present at high values. What is scarce at this tier is not law but continuity: a body this tuned is a passport into exactly one law set and a liability in every other.

name: Void Needle
summary: Sends one thread of qi past a body's defences instead of through them. Dark is strong against light and nothing else, so it is a specialist answer, not a default.

name: Void Refinement
summary: Capacity 225, spent emptying the dantian of everything that was never assimilated rather than filling it. Raw qi held past its refinement fouls the core, so this gate is subtraction and is priced accordingly at 500 progress. The eight meridians are unchanged. No temporal imprint exists here, so a tide is the only cheap way to attempt it.

name: Ren Mai
summary: The vessel of the front midline, tier 9, open from rung 11. Where du_mai governs what the body commands, ren_mai governs what it receives, and a practitioner trained on one and not the other has learned half a circuit. It carries four nodes, tied for the fullest on the network.

name: Bone Mending Splint
summary: Splints and knits a fracture between one breath and the next. Pure restoration; the qi goes into the mend and none of it comes back as a strike.

name: Essence Reserve Method
summary: Teaches both halves of the body to bank what they take in rather than spending it at once. Deeper essence and faster recovery, bought with a universal slot.

name: Footwork Basics
summary: Where the feet go when nothing else is happening. Unelemental and cheap, but it takes a universal slot, which is a slot a path technique could have used.

name: Recovery Breath
summary: A five-breath pattern that returns a usable amount of qi in a few seconds. Unelemental, restorative, and gated on the best path rather than any one of them.

name: Tempered Will
summary: A discipline for holding a decision through the moment it hurts. Harden the will and lift the spirit that carries it; the only passive that reaches so high from the shared pool.

name: Wound Pressure Points
summary: Sets qi into an injury to slow the bleed instead of treating it. Does almost no damage and keeps a badly hurt practitioner conscious, which is its whole use.

name: Small Intestine
summary: Tier 3, added at rung 5. It is the second half of the extraction the ladder runs on: what the stomach passes, this separates. A practitioner whose small intestine is blocked can still fill a dantian for a while, which is exactly why the failure is mistaken for progress in the early bands.

name: Spleen
summary: Tier 0, and the fourth of the first gate. It is the least dramatic of the four and the one whose loss is hardest to attribute: a body without it still draws breath and still digests, and simply stops converting either into anything. Mortal-band cultivation is cheap because this vessel is cheap; nothing above rung 1 is.

name: Stomach
summary: Tier 0 and open at rung 1 - the third leg of the four that must be open before any dantian can hold anything. Every later tier's breakthrough pill is assayed against this vessel, because what a body can absorb decides what it can be fed. Severed, it is survivable and never again economical.

name: Technique Magnitude Table
summary: The per-realm technique magnitude table, and the second power-shaped number in the setting on purpose: 1.0 at qi_refining rising to 2.77x at primordial_origin, keyed by realm id. It exists because a technique rides ON TOP of a realm rather than being one, and a single multiplier would have to choose between the actor table at 551x and this. Never derive one from the other, and never derive either from a realm index.

attributes.note: two orders of magnitude below the actor table by design

name: Triple Burner
summary: Tier 6, open at rung 8. It governs the three burners - the upper, middle and lower divisions a body digests through - and it is the only ordinary vessel whose name describes a function rather than a place. Damaged, heat and cold stop being distributed and start being local, which reads as mysterious illness rather than as an injury.

name: Yang Qiao
summary: Tier 12, open at rung 14, and the mirror of yin_qiao on the outside of the leg. The two are opened together or not at all: authored as a pair, they are the rung-14 gate's whole content, and crossing one alone is the body's first topological gate.

name: Yang Wei
summary: Tier 15, opening at rung 17 alongside yin_wei, and the network's outermost boundary. Body Dao reads it as the last thing holding the form in; Mind Dao reads the same group as the first thing a self crosses on the way out. The two traditions agree it opens at rung 17 and disagree about everything it is for.

name: Yin Qiao
summary: Opens at rung 14, with its yang counterpart, and is the first of the eight extraordinary vessels to serve motion rather than storage. It runs the inside of the leg and the fastest route between two states of attention, which is why a mind practitioner uses it as a corridor and a body practitioner uses it as a spring.

name: Yin Wei
summary: The last of the extraordinary vessels to open, at rung 17 - the gate that closes the network. It connects what the other seven carry to what the body will actually do with it, so nothing above this rung is a matter of opening something new. Four nodes, two of them celestial, make it the vessel that most defines a finished composition.
